name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1906: Routine I is the only thing that judges two CSS invariants and it takes long enough that the next push cancels it - twelve consecutive runs from v1894 to v1902 are all cancelled, and v1903 was the first to reach a verdict since v1893, going red on two defects I had shipped myself: a set-quality green that drifted from the settled palette in the TZ tracker, and a --dim token in the console rendering as two colours because both fallbacks were live. A gate that never reaches a verdict reads exactly like one that passed, and the cause was my own push cadence against his rule to batch. Both are fixed - the soon countdown uses the same green its own live dot already uses - and both invariants now run in the python suites where they cannot be cancelled, with the palette parsed out of the spec rather than copied.
